purpose: Original AI-generated editorial course illustrations, not photographs of actual classes or student results

entries.label: 实用工具：学习计划应用
entries.prompt: Create ONE landscape 16:9 premium course-cover image for VIBE CODING, an 8–16-year-old creative coding school. Photorealistic editorial still life of a real, unbranded silver laptop on a pale warm studio desk, its screen showing a beautifully simple habit-tracker / study-planner app prototype built by a beginner: large orderly checkboxes, a weekly grid, one warm orange progress ring, clear cream/ink interface without legible text. Beside it a small paper wireframe sketch and one orange pencil. This should immediately communicate making useful software on a computer, not shopping for hardware. Camera at gentle three-quarter angle, laptop screen facing camera, natural soft side light, restrained premium material detail, subtle paper texture, crisp realistic display. Color palette warm white, near-black and vivid #FF7A00 orange accents. Focus subject fills central 70 percent; keep upper-left corner clean for an overlaid course-category chip, preserve the whole screen safely within center so wide banner cropping works. No people, no hands, no headphones, no logos, no brand names, no advertising headlines, no baked-in typography outside the screen, no watermarks, no floating holograms, no sci-fi, no cartoony robot. This is an original illustrative course concept, not a photo of real students.

entries.label: AI 应用：植物识别与检查
entries.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: premium 16:9 landscape course cover for an 8–16-year-old creative coding education app, ONE photograph, not a collage.
An unbranded silver laptop sits on a warm pale ivory studio desk. Its screen faces the viewer and clearly shows a refined, child-friendly plant-identification AI app prototype: an input leaf photograph at left, flowing to three compact candidate plant cards at right, with understated confidence bars and check icons. The interface feels like a real plausible simple student project, crisp, organized, sage green and cream with a small #FF7A00 action shape. A real small green leaf and a single plain paper input-check-output flow sketch sit on the desk beside the laptop. Software input, checking and output are visibly tangible, not science fiction.
Premium photorealistic editorial still life, beautiful natural materials, subtle brushed aluminum, soft daylight, precise gentle shadows, calm sophisticated warm ivory and sage palette. Laptop and complete screen remain inside the center 70% of the wide frame, with balanced clear margins and enough headroom for crop-safe placement; slight 3/4 perspective but screen is highly readable as an interface. Fine realistic textures and restrained styling.
No people, no hands, no headphones, no robots, no holograms, no logos, no watermarks, no advertising, no giant typography. No text outside the screen or paper. Screen labels may be very small neutral UI microcopy only; prioritize recognizable coherent UI graphics over text.
